method: Sequential source-code review of modal markup, handlers, shared presentation/dismissal scripts, and guided CSS. Findings are code-level; this is not an end-to-end browser certification.
shared_policy: Backdrop and Escape dismissal are disabled. Every modal therefore needs a visible explicit exit. Shared EV presentation injects Close for setup, map, completion and video picker dialogs; ordinary hidden legacy buttons are not proof of an exit trap.

findings.trigger: Realize an earlier crop/contact/commitment is wrong after confirming it.
findings.roadblock: Forward-only swingTagStep transitions, no guided return/edit action; preset contact skips contact entirely. Guided CSS hides legacy tag buttons and header children. The start confirmation saves immediately.
findings.recommendation: Offer one compact Edit earlier step action preserving the other tags; include contact even when prefilled. Revalidate tag order before saving.

findings.trigger: Need to revise crop after entering contact, or review an incorrect prefilled contact.
findings.roadblock: No transition back to crop; HAS_PRESET_CONTACT causes crop confirmation to proceed directly to upload. The local Close button is hidden by CSS.
findings.recommendation: Always make prefilled contact reviewable; provide Edit crop and a visible local exit. Preserve the selected frame and description.

findings.trigger: Reach Yes/No and need to leave or revise an earlier mark.
findings.roadblock: setupBack/setupCancel hidden; CSS also hides injected .ev-dialog-close on groundChoice. Only Yes, No and destructive Start over remain locally available.
findings.recommendation: Keep Close available and provide a compact revision entry point without adding a row of navigation buttons.

findings.trigger: Notice a prior home/rubber/baseline click is wrong while marking subsequent landmarks.
findings.roadblock: Guided controls are emptied and Continue is hidden; workflow navigation contains Start over and Not visible rather than a prior-mark selector. Completed field-mark review defaults to a landmark but offers no clear visible selection of another completed landmark.
findings.recommendation: Make each existing field mark selectable on the picture, then replace only that mark. Keep completion explicit and preserve unrelated marks.

findings.flow: EV accepted automatic path → revise a point
findings.trigger: One late automatic point is wrong but the rest of the detection is good.
findings.roadblock: Review offers whole-track accept/reject. Named edit helpers target contact and fixed 10/15/20/25-frame positions, use manualBallObservations, and their legacy button handlers can be attached to absent elements after guided content is replaced. There is no direct late automatic-point selection in the contact picture.
findings.recommendation: Click a numbered point to correct or omit that specific observation at its actual timestamp; preserve all other approved points and invalidate the prediction.

findings.roadblock: Continue explicitly requires Start over rather than repairing selection, after all map and video marks are already complete.
findings.recommendation: Open a focused repair selector only when required; retain all measurement work.

findings.trigger: Need to change address, camera or home after progressing to landing confirmation.
findings.roadblock: Back is hidden in points/confirm and shared presentation hides the legacy map Back control globally; confirmation hides map step controls. Start over in points/confirm clears all map points. Injected Close permits exit but is not revision navigation.
findings.recommendation: One Edit map mark action should reveal existing camera/home/axis/landing choices and address without clearing other marks.

findings.trigger: Close the outer modal to return to another screen, then reopen the unfinished flow.
findings.roadblock: closeMenuFlow unloads non-EV iframe to about:blank. Reopening menu links assigns a new iframe URL. Client-only crop/tag/form changes can be lost; EV is preserved on close but explicit EV entry clears the iframe again.
findings.recommendation: Use a consistent resume/discard policy for unfinished work, with state persistence before unloading.

findings.flow: Saved library → pitch/swing playback → fix tags
findings.trigger: Discover an incorrect finalized pitch contact/crop or swing timing tag.
findings.roadblock: Library actions expose description editing, pitch speed editing and EV setup editing, but no equivalent pitch/swing crop or timing re-tag action. Users may have to return to source and recreate the clip.
findings.recommendation: Expose Edit tags using the saved source and existing markers; explicitly handle any dependent matchups when applying revisions.

separate_fit_change.cause: prepare_staged_flight accepted manual sources only, excluding explicitly approved automatic observations and forcing the full XY fallback.
separate_fit_change.fix: Allow explicitly human-reviewed usable detections without changing their CV provenance or confidence.
separate_fit_change.regression: 7 staged-fit tests passed, including equivalent manual/reviewed-CV results, exclusion of unreviewed CV, late X invariance, late Y sensitivity, distance-check separation, and invalid calibration handling.
separate_fit_change.limits: Level camera and no zoom assumed; later horizontal displacement is not scored. Late vertical camera motion is not corrected by this change. Model sensitivity is not independently validated accuracy. Saved hit/database not modified. Python model reloads on the next prediction without a server restart.
